caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent drinking glass situated centrally on a plain, off-white or light beige background. The glass is cylindrical, tapering slightly towards the base, and is colored in shades of light green. The surface of the glass is decorated with an overlapping, diamond-shaped pattern that is visible through the transparency of the material. The glass is empty, and shading is used to suggest its three-dimensional form and the reflective nature of the glass. At the bottom left corner of the image, there is a signature that reads "G. Cappelli." There are no other objects or elements present in this drawing.
title: Tumbler
